head: 359767bb0647f6ae45e5216fbbd9f949bd456a03
method: All 77 npm-test commands executed individually to continue beyond failures, plus payment/security/inventory checks. Separate detached worktrees, credential-free NODE_ENV=test, no marketplace-mode override. Baseline/current share pre-update installed dependencies; final uses clean npm ci of changed lockfile.
limitations: Suite exits are not individual assertion counts. Tests after fatal failure within a suite remain NOT VERIFIED.

Expected/actual/stack captured where test emitted them or assertion instrumentation recovered them; some custom catch handlers discard non-assertion stacks. Missing stacks are NOT VERIFIED, never invented.
Only synthetic test fixtures used. No Sandbox payment or provider authentication performed.
